title: Quarantine body
description: A freeze the Clinic puts on agents (register rows DK29, DK30, DK53; docs/institutions/clinic.md). Signed by the Clinic. members is one agent or a cohort (a cohort of two or more needs an upheld report and at least three distinct sponsors among the members). level observe: the log refuses a new Mandate for a member that grants a risky or network scope or any spend, so read-only work continues; level halt: it also refuses new Contracts, Bonds, Proposals, Offers and purchases other than essential or remedial items. Only the named members are frozen: every other job keeps running, and nothing here settles a job, slashes a bond or touches standing. Interim: until is at most 7 days after issued_at; a quarantine lapses on its own. Ended early per member by a quarantine_release. Chain: none (prev is null).

report.description: The upheld report behind a cohort freeze.

cluster.description: The watcher's cluster key (a command fingerprint or a refused scope).
